'''MSP80 Pteropter hover pods''', also known as '''MSP80 Pteropter repulsorlift airspeeders''' or '''[[Trandoshan]] skiffs''', were [[airspeeder]]s that were used by [[Garnac]]'s [[Garnac's hunting guild|hunting guild]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. A different variant was used by the [[Pyke Syndicate]] on [[Oba Diah]].

==Description==
MSP80 Pteropter hover pods,<ref name="EGPL" /> also known as [[Trandoshan]] skiffs,<ref name="DB">{{Databank|trandoshan-skiff|Trandoshan skiff}}</ref> were used as the main [[Airspeeder|transportation]] for [[Garnac]]'s [[Garnac's hunting guild|hunting guild]] on their hunts. The hover pods could hold multiple passengers and were equipped with multiple weapons systems. They were customized with various [[color]]s and designs.<ref name="PL" />

==History==
When [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] met a group of former Padawans also stranded on the hunting [[moon]] [[Wasskah]], they conspired to escape the moon, stealing a hover pod from two of the hunters, [[Crix]] and [[Smug]], and using it to fly to the [[Trandoshan]]'s [[Ubrikkian Floating Fortress|base]].<ref name="WH">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

Near the end of the [[Clone Wars]], Tano commandeered a variant of the hover pod to rescue her comrades [[Trace Martez|Trace]] and [[Rafa Martez]], who had been captured and were about to be executed by the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. However, the hover pod was damaged by a [[laser cannon]], and the three were recaptured.<ref name="Dangerous Debt" />
